title: Funds for Pitt-Greenville Airport
aiSummary: This bill appropriates $10 million in state highway funds to the Pitt-Greenville Airport for constructing a new general aviation terminal designed to address flood mitigation concerns. The funds would be made available starting July 1, 2025.
aiProArguments: Supporters argue this investment improves critical infrastructure for regional aviation and economic development in Eastern North Carolina. The flood mitigation component addresses safety concerns and protects airport operations from weather-related disruptions, potentially reducing future disaster recovery costs.
aiConArguments: Opponents may question whether highway funds should be diverted to airport projects, argue the $10 million allocation is excessive for a general aviation terminal, or contend that local/federal resources should bear more of the cost. Some may also question whether flood mitigation justifies the expense or if alternative solutions would be more cost-effective.
